lines: Best placement of the ≥ 1″ area: RRFS (ETS 0.11).
Closest on the peak: HRRR, 1.74″ vs 2.16″ observed at its resolution (81%).
Earliest signal: ECMWF IFS reached half the observed peak 108 h before the window started.
summary.method: Score = mean of placement (ETS at the event threshold ÷ 0.5, capped at 1), peak (e^-|ln ratio| of forecast to observed near-max at the model's resolution) and volume (e^-|ln bias|), each from the model's shortest-lead run.
